capabilities: Open external links in a split-pane Web Viewer
Reuse a single Web Viewer pane to swap URLs in place
Open a new Web Viewer tab with Shift+click
Invert the default target (Web Viewer vs. system browser) with Cmd/Ctrl+click
extras: README is mostly in Chinese. The repository also contains a companion Chrome extension (in development, load-unpacked only) that routes Shift+clicks to Chrome 140+'s native split view; it requires manually opening the first tab in split view because Chrome's API cannot do so programmatically. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: 基于 Obsidian 原生 Web Viewer，把外链分屏打开
motivation: The author wanted links to open 'beside' the current view — replacing content in the same panel or stacking in the same group — instead of switching screens or opening new windows per click.
problem: Obsidian's default external-link handling forces you to switch panes or leave to a browser on every click, with no way to keep the link open beside your note.
summary: Link router that opens external links in Obsidian's Web Viewer in a split pane, with modifier-key options for tabs, reuse, and the browser.
